candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 to /v1/checkout.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout correlate with downstream order service 500s on /v1/orders across traces and logs; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Order-side cause is unobserved, so the bounded candidate is the propagated 500.
